front_door.description: Recessed under a shared stuccoed porch with decorative columns; dark-coloured door with transom/fanlight above.

access_notes: Narrow frontage with small front garden behind a low brick wall and gate opening.
Shallow step(s) up into the porch.
Wheelie bins stored at the front boundary.
Street tree on pavement directly outside/near the frontage.
On-street parking both sides; single carriageway street.
No hydrant marker or standpipe plate visibly seen in the images.
rear_access_note: Mid-terrace; rear garden backs onto other rear gardens with no alleyway or side passage visible on satellite view.
parking: Kerbside on the street directly outside or opposite, in gaps between parked vehicles.
